<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="brandGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="3" stdDeviation="5" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".14"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="22" y="20" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <line x1="326" y1="13" x2="326" y2="19" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="331" y1="11" x2="331" y2="19" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="336" y1="9" x2="336" y2="19" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="349" cy="15" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="352" y1="18" x2="355" y2="21" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="363" y="9" width="20" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="365" y="11" width="15" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="384" y="12" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>

  <!-- top navigation -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="29,55 21,63 29,71" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="195" y="68" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#4A4A4A">Add Photos</text>
    <circle cx="365" cy="63" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="365" y="68" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#939393">?</text>
  </g>

  <!-- progress indicator -->
  <g>
    <rect x="21" y="88" width="55" height="4" rx="2" fill="url(#brandGradient)"/>
    <rect x="83" y="88" width="55" height="4" rx="2" fill="url(#brandGradient)"/>
    <rect x="145" y="88" width="55" height="4" rx="2" fill="url(#brandGradient)"/>
    <rect x="207" y="88" width="55" height="4" rx="2" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <rect x="269" y="88" width="55" height="4" rx="2" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <rect x="331" y="88" width="38" height="4" rx="2" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
  </g>

  <text x="21" y="124" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="26" font-weight="700" fill="#4A4A4A">Show your best side</text>
  <text x="21" y="148" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Add at least 2 photos to continue</text>

  <!-- photo card shadows -->
  <g opacity=".11" fill="#000000">
    <rect x="21" y="177" width="168" height="143" rx="12"/>
    <rect x="201" y="177" width="168" height="143" rx="12"/>
    <rect x="21" y="335" width="168" height="143" rx="12"/>
    <rect x="201" y="335" width="168" height="143" rx="12"/>
    <rect x="21" y="493" width="168" height="143" rx="12"/>
    <rect x="201" y="493" width="168" height="143" rx="12"/>
  </g>

  <!-- existing photo 1 -->
  <g>
    <rect x="21" y="174" width="168" height="143" rx="12" fill="#D0CECD"/>
    <rect x="21" y="174" width="168" height="143" rx="12" fill="#939393" opacity=".25"/>
    <circle cx="145" cy="218" r="24" fill="#EFC54D" opacity=".9"/>
    <polygon points="21,286 75,232 108,263 132,245 189,303 189,317 21,317" fill="#96E063" opacity=".9"/>
    <polygon points="21,300 68,264 98,286 127,269 189,314 189,317 21,317" fill="#4396F7" opacity=".65"/>
    <circle cx="177" cy="188" r="15" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="171" y1="182" x2="183" y2="194" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="183" y1="182" x2="171" y2="194" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="30" y="288" width="57" height="20" rx="10" fill="#000000" opacity=".42"/>
    <text x="58" y="302" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">PHOTO 1</text>
  </g>

  <!-- existing photo 2 -->
  <g>
    <rect x="201" y="174" width="168" height="143" rx="12" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <rect x="201" y="174" width="168" height="143" rx="12" fill="#EA5D6B" opacity=".22"/>
    <circle cx="334" cy="218" r="24" fill="#FF7854" opacity=".85"/>
    <polygon points="201,292 252,240 282,267 309,245 369,304 369,317 201,317" fill="#FE3675" opacity=".78"/>
    <polygon points="201,302 245,270 278,289 311,265 369,314 369,317 201,317" fill="#4A4A4A" opacity=".5"/>
    <circle cx="357" cy="188" r="15" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="351" y1="182" x2="363" y2="194" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="363" y1="182" x2="351" y2="194" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="210" y="288" width="57" height="20" rx="10" fill="#000000" opacity=".42"/>
    <text x="238" y="302" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">PHOTO 2</text>
  </g>

  <!-- add slot 3 -->
  <g>
    <rect x="21" y="332" width="168" height="143" rx="12" fill="#F5F7FA" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="105" cy="397" r="25" fill="url(#brandGradient)"/>
    <line x1="105" y1="385" x2="105" y2="409" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <line x1="93" y1="397" x2="117" y2="397" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <text x="105" y="447" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">ADD PHOTO</text>
  </g>

  <!-- add slot 4 -->
  <g>
    <rect x="201" y="332" width="168" height="143" rx="12" fill="#F5F7FA" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="285" cy="397" r="25" fill="url(#brandGradient)"/>
    <line x1="285" y1="385" x2="285" y2="409" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <line x1="273" y1="397" x2="297" y2="397" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <text x="285" y="447" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">ADD PHOTO</text>
  </g>

  <!-- add slot 5 -->
  <g>
    <rect x="21" y="490" width="168" height="143" rx="12" fill="#F5F7FA" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="105" cy="555" r="25" fill="url(#brandGradient)"/>
    <line x1="105" y1="543" x2="105" y2="567" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <line x1="93" y1="555" x2="117" y2="555" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <text x="105" y="605" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">ADD PHOTO</text>
  </g>

  <!-- add slot 6 -->
  <g>
    <rect x="201" y="490" width="168" height="143" rx="12" fill="#F5F7FA" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="285" cy="555" r="25" fill="url(#brandGradient)"/>
    <line x1="285" y1="543" x2="285" y2="567" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <line x1="273" y1="555" x2="297" y2="555" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <text x="285" y="605" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">ADD PHOTO</text>
  </g>

  <!-- helper and continue -->
  <text x="195" y="664" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">You can add up to 6 photos</text>
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="68" y="683" width="254" height="44" rx="22" fill="url(#brandGradient)"/>
  </g>
  <text x="195" y="710" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">CONTINUE</text>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="759" width="390" height="1" fill="#EAEDF1"/>
  <g>
    <!-- discover -->
    <circle cx="39" cy="786" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <polygon points="35,790 38,782 45,779 42,787" fill="#939393"/>
    <text x="39" y="816" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">DISCOVER</text>

    <!-- likes -->
    <circle cx="130" cy="786" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="125" y1="786" x2="135" y2="786" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <line x1="130" y1="781" x2="130" y2="791" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <text x="130" y="816" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">LIKES</text>

    <!-- matches -->
    <rect x="211" y="777" width="20" height="15" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <polygon points="216,792 216,797 222,792" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="221" y="816" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">MATCHES</text>

    <!-- profile -->
    <circle cx="326" cy="781" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <ellipse cx="326" cy="794" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="326" y="816" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#FE3675">PROFILE</text>
  </g>

  <!-- home indicator -->
  <rect x="145" y="833" width="100" height="4" rx="2" fill="#000000"/>
</svg>
